{{Quote|They're called garrals. The Empire used to use them as watchdogs, usually near heavily wooded frontier garrisons where probe droid pickets weren't practical.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''garral''' was a [[Canine/Legends|canine]] pack hunter [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically engineered]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Luthos Garral]], who crossed the genes of the [[Mantessan panthac]] with those of several other creatures. The Galactic Empire deployed them to supplement [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security forces]], for example to the forests of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to protect the [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] facility. According to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], these animals used to be used as watchdogs for the Empire.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|There's something in the ultrasonic signature of a repulsorlift that's supposed to sound like one of their prey animals. Draws them like a magnet.|Mara Jade|<ref name="The Last Command" />}}
Garrals looked almost identical to their genetic template, [[Mantessan panthac]]s, but larger. They had a speckled coat of gray fur along their backs, thick manes around their necks and shoulders, and long, tufted tails.<ref name="Even More Aliens!" />

[[File:Garral.png|thumb|left|200px|A pack of garrals]]
Garrals were attracted to the ultrasonic noises created by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]; they could hear one from hundreds of meters away. Such sounds nearby drove them into a killing frenzy to attack any unrecognized living or moving thing.<ref name="Even More Aliens!" />

[[Bioengineering/Legends|Genetically engineered]] by Imperial garrison commander [[Luthos Garral]], they had a good temper for a pack hunter animal. The main template was combined with several less vicious predators and a few domesticated creatures. The resulting animal eventually was perfected as a loyal, alert, easily handled animal common in many Imperial outposts in the fringe worlds. Closer to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], Imperial reliance on technology made garrals less common because of their acute repulsor sensitivity.<ref name="Even More Aliens!" />

The garrals had litters of two to eight cubs and were very protective of their young. Only a trusted and experienced handler could get near a garral mother. Garrals grew to their full length of two meters in three years and had a life span of 30 years.<ref name="Even More Aliens!" />

==Behavior==
[[File:GarralBlasted-TLC4.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Han Solo blasts an attacking garral on Wayland]]
Garrals lived in packs, defending the pack leader. They often treated their handlers as pack leaders, following and protecting them even when not directed to do so.<ref name="Even More Aliens!" />

==History==
[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] encountered garrals somewhere in the Empire, but even in her work as the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] never saw a reference to where the creatures originated. She was familiar enough with them, however, to know that garrals were usually radiotagged with a collar which would inform their controllers of the presence of a repulsorlift. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] never saw them before, but encountered Mantessan panthacs at some point when visiting [[Mantessa]].

Mara, Han, and Chewbacca, along with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], ran into several garrals on Wayland during their trek to Mount Tantiss when they first attempted to activate their speeder bikes. After this first encounter, however, the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] who were trailing them disposed of any other potential attackers.

By the time of the [[New Jedi Order]], [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], and even the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] occasionally used them.<ref name="Even More Aliens!" />
